prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a small house in an underground city carved inside a huge cave. Carved stone overhang roof. Walls carved directly into grey rock with iron-bound wooden doors and small round windows, pipes. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.

Guide canvas 1232x1120 corresponding to native 176x160 art pixels magnified exactly 7x via nearest neighbour. STRICTLY preserve guide coordinates and shape: magenta is FULL TRANSPARENCY; stone roof overhang silhouette x14–1219, y196–714; upper roof visible from above y196–422, its horizontal dark division/eave at y423–437, lower roof-facing band y438–714; stone FRONT WALL x56–1176, y715–1119. Keep exactly roof/wall boundary at y715. Front entrance EXACTLY centered x539–693 y896–1119, a rectangular walk-through iron-bound dark wooden door reaching the bottom, same size, no steps in front. Keep TWO windows at guide positions, left x238–350 y896–1037 and right x868–980 y896–1037; keep their original bounding rectangular sizes and positions while rendering SMALL ROUND amber-glowing windows inset within these rectangular openings, with rock surround / iron rim; do not relocate or resize overall window features. The windows are the only warm light, no light pools. Carve building into grey rock, substantial layered carved-stone overhang roof with weathered blocky rock fissures, warm grey/blue grey stony faceted clusters; rock walls in muted grey with carved ashlar seams and purple/red saturated shadow ramps, subtly warm yellow highlights; iron door bands, two or three little metal rivets, simple handle, pipes neatly against wall. Clean neutral soft evenly illuminated base asset, not dark. Lived-in earthy tones. Crisp premium modern HD pixel-art JRPG tile asset; all details composed of clear hand-placed hard-edged clusters of 3–10 NATIVE pixels, every square pixel exactly uniform 7x7 final image pixels, strictly pixel aligned. No antialias, no blur, no fine grain, no checkerboard dithering, no photographic texture, no soft brush. No other buildings, no ground, no cast shadow, no people, no text. Fully transparent background, absolutely no magenta remaining.
